summary: Smoke/regression after UPDATE-MAIN branch import from luchii-ai-models/Luchii. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iter61_import_smoke.py — API root ('Luchii API online', publisher Frasberg), admin login (admin@frasbergai.com/Federation20261+, role=admin), /api/auth/me after cookie-login, new-user register+login, documented test user login (test@luchii.ai/Test1234! — auto-registered if missing), creator app mount verified via /api/creator/gpu/v1/engines (200), /api/creator/auth/me (401 unauth / 200 authed), public endpoints /api/public/showcase + /api/public/models (<500), and chat endpoint. Frontend: homepage renders the Luchii/Frasberg site with hero 'Intelligence that truly gets you.' and full nav (Sign In, AI Models, Realms, API, Website Builder, Game Builder, Games, FrasbergOS) — visually matches the Frasberg reference preview. All 9 requested routes (/ai-models, /website-builder, /game-builder, /games, /os, /gallery, /about, /dashboard, /luchii) return HTTP 200 and render content with no crash banner. Login via /auth?mode=login succeeds and redirects to /chat. Frasberg Creator at /create renders behind AuthGate with its tab shell (Create, Features & Tools, Models) and AI Image Generator UI; /creator route also renders. Chat demo on homepage calls /api/chat (SSE) and returns a graceful fallback error stream ('⚠ Luchii hit turbulence on that reply — please resend your message.') with HTTP 200 — expected since user chose not to configure EMERGENT_LLM_KEY and the upstream LUCHII_UPSTREAM_URL is unreachable. No stacktrace, no 5xx.
critical_code_review_comments: Problem statement listed GET /api/gpu/v1/engines but the actual route is /api/creator/gpu/v1/engines (creator_app mounts with prefix=/api/creator). Harmless — tests updated — but worth noting for any consumer docs.

Chat demo returns a fallback SSE message with 200 OK when both EMERGENT_LLM_KEY and upstream LUCHII_UPSTREAM_URL are unavailable. UX-wise good (no crash), but there is no visible UI indicator that the model is offline/degraded.
/dashboard and /luchii render with very small content bodies (~300 chars) — likely gated/redirect shells. No crash, but worth confirming the gated UX is intentional and not an empty-state regression.
